column1: # Simple Telex 2 (VIKEY_TELEX_STYLE=2, D56): [ and ] are brackets, a lone w is still ư.

column6: a bracket ends the word, it is not ơ
the word after a bracket is typed fresh
a closing bracket after a word
uw and ow still make ư and ơ
a lone w is still ư
w after a consonant is still ư
a lone W is still Ư
a bracket ends the word like . or ,: an English word is put back (not zẻo[)
a closing bracket after an English word
a bracket ends the digit too: the next lone w is ư
